file_structure.single_metabolite_analysis.py: runs comparison models using individual metabolites
file_structure.evaluation.py: computes prediction stability, effect estimates, confidence intervals, and summary tables
file_structure.visualization.py: generates matplotlib figures for model comparison and stability results
file_structure.main.py: orchestrates the full experiment from data loading to result export
file_structure.app.py: optional interface or reporting entry point for loading trained outputs and visualizing predictions
